> The DentalBrace Clinic & Implant Centre is Bathinda's leading dental specialty clinic, run by two AIIMS-trained specialists. The clinic provides advanced orthodontic and implantology services for patients from across the Malwa region of Punjab, India.

## About the Clinic
- **Full Name**: The DentalBrace Clinic & Implant Centre
- **Location**: 196, Bibi Wala Road, near LIC Building, opposite Petrol Pump, Kamla Nehru Colony, Bathinda, Punjab 151001, India
- **Phone**: +91 74968-49392
- **Website**: https://www.thedentalbrace.com
- **Hours**: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–8:00 PM; Sunday Closed
- **Languages**: Hindi, Punjabi, English
- **Established**: 2014+

## Frequently Asked Questions
- How much does Invisalign cost in Bathinda? → Varies by case; book a consultation for personalised pricing.
- Are dental implants painful? → Placed under local anesthesia; minimal discomfort. Dr. Ritu has placed 5,000+ implants.
- What is All-on-4? → Full arch (12-14 teeth) on 4 implants. Faster, more economical than individual replacements.
- Do you offer EMI options? → Yes, 0% interest EMI through Bajaj Finserv Health Card and other schemes.
- What are the clinic hours? → Mon–Sat 9AM–8PM. Emergency line available.
